title: National Junior Camp Begins for BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati, bringing together India's promising young shuttlers.

title: BAI Conducts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the coaching standards across India, directly impacting the development of future Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) successfully organized its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The release of these regulations sets the stage for one of India's key domestic team events, fostering state-level competition.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and eligibility criteria for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This notification impacts the selection process for India's women's doubles contingent for the prestigious World Junior Championships.
summary: A notification regarding a change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has been issued by the BAI.

title: Indian Team Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships Underway
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's young talents to compete against the best in Asia at the U17 and U15 Junior Championships.
summary: The Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on player readiness.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change in domestic junior tournaments will impact player strategy and development across India's youth badminton circuit.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
